options.vitrail.crash_graphics_api_toolt:
Graphics used after a launch that did not finish.
"Vulkan" keeps shader packs. "OpenGL" draws none. "Game default" is the game's rescue.
options.vitrail.metal4_tooltip:
Uses Metallum's experimental Metal 4 renderer.
Off uses the stable Metal 3 path.
Changes take effect after restarting the game.
Metal 4 is experimental and may still have compatibility or performance issues.
options.vitrail.shadow_distance_tooltip:
Terrain and entities past this range cast no shadow.
Lower is faster. "Off" skips the shadow map.
Applies at once. No pack reload.
options.vitrail.shadow_distance_forced: This pack already set a shadow distance. The slider cannot move.
options.vitrail.shadow_map_scale_tooltip:
Share of the pack's shadow map that is actually drawn.
Lower is faster, and edges get softer or coarser. "100%" is what the pack asked for.
Reloads the pack.
options.vitrail.render_scale_tooltip:
Renders the 3D world at this percentage of the window and upscales it with MetalFX.
Lower values can improve performance at the cost of image clarity.
100% renders at native resolution and disables MetalFX; the interface always stays native-resolution.
Changes apply on the next frame without reloading the shader pack.
If MetalFX is unavailable, Vitrail uses a regular upscale as a compatibility fallback.
options.vitrail.shadow_amortisation_tool:
How many frames the shadow map is kept before it is drawn again.
Higher is faster: drawing it is the most expensive pass of the frame.
Only the GROUND ages: a block you place or break keeps its old shadow that long.
Applies at the next frame. No pack reload.
options.vitrail.module_cache_ceiling_too:
How much compiled-shader disk this engine may keep.
"512 MiB" is what it ships. Lower drops unused units sooner.
Applies at once. No pack reload.
